bio: Engraved the matrices for the Lokasangrah type, a 24-point Devanagari face designed by S. K. Sant and introduced by the Lokasangrah Press in Poona in 1941.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume One, pp. 316–318 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra
